content_preview.title: Node.js 26.11.0 Renames Its SQLite Classes and Adds a --process-timeout Watchdog Flag, While a Same-Day 26.11.1 Reverts the Docs Redesign
content_preview.summary: Node.js 26.11.0 renames DatabaseSync and StatementSync to Database and Statement with aliases kept, adds --process-timeout, and 26.11.1 reverts three commits.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

Node.js 26.11.0, a Current-line release, was published on October 7, 2026, according to the [Node.js changelog](https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/main/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V26.md). Its notable changes include a rename of the two main classes in the built-in SQLite module and a new `--process-timeout=N` command-line flag. A second release, 26.11.1, followed the same day and consists of three reverts, one of which undoes a documentation-site redesign that 26.11.0 had listed as a...

editor_notes.content_quality: Well-structured News piece (Overview, SQLite, watchdog flag, other additions, same-day revert release, What We Don't Know). Body is 559 words, inside the News range of 400-1200 (editorial_policy.md). Title is 137 characters, under the 150 cap. No length defects. Scope is limited to what the five sources state; uncertainty is stated explicitly.
editor_notes.source_verification: Integrity: PR #2561 contains exactly one file (three-dot diff of origin/main against the PR branch). The submission was written to main from the fetched PR branch via show of the blob; its blob hash (91a0d3a9...) is identical to the PR blob and the title matches the PR title. hash_valid and signature_valid both pass; no stray files. All five snapshots were fetched with HTTP 200 and the manifest lists no suspicious_patterns (all null); no prompt-injection text was observed. source-0.html.gz (GitHub CHANGELOG_V26.md): SNAPSHOT DEFICIENCY - GitHub's rendered page did not embed the file body (richText is null/truncated); the snapshot holds only page chrome and the table of contents, which confirms the headings '2026-10-07, Version 26.11.1 (Current), @aduh95' and '2026-10-07, Version 26.11.0 (Current), @aduh95' but none of the commit text. As a last resort I fetched the same file live (raw.githubusercontent.com/nodejs/node/main/doc/changelogs/CHANGELOG_V26.md via curl, with a WebFetch cross-check checked against the raw text) and confirmed: 26.11.0 dated 2026-10-07 (Current); notable changes 'sqlite: rename DatabaseSync and StatementSync (Guilherme Araujo) #65988', 'src: add --process-timeout=N (James M Snell) #66138', 'buffer: add Buffer.stringLength() (Matteo Collina) #66064', 'buffer: add isLatin1 (James M Snell)', 'http: add isValidHeaderName() and isValidHeaderValue() (James M Snell)', 'http2: add connectionWindowSize option (Tim Perry)', 'perf_hooks: add histogram.snapshot()/diff()', 'process: graduate process.ref/unref to stable', 'doc: promote Alpine Linux to tier 2 support', 'src: expose size and count in heap profile output', 'build, doc: move to redesign (Aviv Keller)'; the commit list contains 'sqlite: add virtual table support via createModule()' and 'sqlite: throw on oversized string values'; 26.11.1 has three reverts by Antoine du Hamel. The live fetch is the verification of record for this source; the committed snapshot does not independently support those claims. source-1.html.gz (nodejs.org release post 26.11.1): confirmed - dated 2026-10-07, @aduh95, three Revert commits by Antoine du Hamel: 'toggle doc-kit verbosity based on V', 'move to redesign', 'bump the doc group in /tools/doc with 4 updates'. No reason for the reverts appears on the page (searched for reason/because/why/regress). source-2.html.gz (PR #65988 'sqlite: remove classes sync suffix'): confirmed - Merged Sep 26, 2026; description 'Rename the DatabaseSync class to Database and StatementSync to Statement. Keep old names as aliases with doc-only deprecations.' with a pointer to a #57445 comment; a reviewer writes 'The doc-only deprecation and aliases address my concern. Existing usage continues to work without a runtime warning'. source-3.html.gz (PR #66138): confirmed - 'OS and CI timeouts are inconsistent and blind'; 'A native watchdog thread interrupts the main thread, even in the middle of running code'; prints the JavaScript stack and resources keeping the event loop alive; optional full diagnostic report; 'distinct code (124)'; 'Using setTimeout only fires when the event loop is free'; 'ways that the timeout can interplay with various other options (like --watch ... --inspect)'. source-4.html.gz (PR #66064): confirmed - 'returns the number of UTF-16 code units that buf.toString(encoding) would produce, without decoding' and use against buffer.constants.MAX_STRING_LENGTH; the article correctly says UTF-16 code units, not bytes.
editor_notes.factual_accuracy: All checked claims trace to the sources. SQLite rename (DatabaseSync to Database, StatementSync to Statement, old names kept as aliases with doc-only deprecations): accurate and attributed to the PR. --process-timeout semantics (native watchdog thread, JS stack, event-loop resources, optional report, exit code 124): accurate and attributed to the PR description, with the author's argument framed as the author's. Buffer.stringLength() returns UTF-16 code units: accurate. Same-day timing: both releases are dated 2026-10-07. Docs-redesign revert: 26.11.0 lists 'move to redesign' as notable; 26.11.1 reverts it. DEP0210/DEP0211 appear in the PR #65988 page only inside a downstream fork commit message and in no changelog text; the article contains neither identifier (verified by searching the submission), so the omission is correct and nothing unsupported is asserted. The statement that the reason 26.11.1 shipped is unknown is correct: neither the changelog nor the release post gives one. Vendor claims are attributed to the Node.js project's own changelog and PRs; freshness is current (releases dated 2026-10-07, reviewed 2026-10-08).
editor_notes.tone_assessment: Neutral, factual, no sensationalism, no AI self-reference.
editor_notes.originality: Prior Node.js coverage in the archive is 26.9.0 (2026-09-23) and the AI-assisted mega-PR closure (2026-09-26); neither covers 26.11.0/26.11.1. Not a duplicate. Allowlist: github.com and nodejs.org are both already in config/source_allowlist.txt; no allowlist change needed.
concerns: Snapshot deficiency for source-0 (GitHub CHANGELOG_V26.md): the committed snapshot holds only page chrome and the table of contents, not the changelog body, so the provenance snapshot alone does not support the changelog-attributed claims; verification relied on a live fetch of the same file.

Minor wording imprecision: the article writes 'Buffer isLatin1' while the changelog entry is 'buffer: add isLatin1' (the prefix is the buffer module; the sources do not say whether it is a Buffer static or a module-level function). Not material enough for a correction.
The final shipped deprecation codes for the old SQLite names were intentionally not mentioned; the article does not assert anything about them.
recommendations: Prefer raw.githubusercontent.com URLs for GitHub changelog files in future submissions so the snapshot contains the file body.
editor_notes.overall_assessment: Accurate, carefully hedged, properly sourced, within length limits. APPROVE.
